# HomeBackupCost

> Independent, source-linked guide to sizing and pricing home backup power (portable power stations, whole-home batteries, generators) in the US, plus rebate status by state. All data as of 2026-10-25; estimates are labeled.

Key facts:
- Home page Quick Check: ZIP + 3 questions gives a ballpark kWh, the cheapest portable setup, installed and generator options, and state rebates.
- Federal 25D (battery) and 25C (heat pump) tax credits do not apply to work completed/placed in service after 12/31/2025 (IRS OBBB FAQ).
- Typical installed whole-home battery (~13.5 kWh): ~$15,647; ~$1,130–$1,159/kWh (EnergySage).
- Calculator method: kWh needed = Σ(typical running W × qty × hours/day) × days / 1000 / 0.85 (0.85 usable-capacity factor is an assumption). Peak W = Σ max running W + largest single starting surge.
